title: QCode-Method project config
description: Written by `qcode generate` at scaffold time; read by sync/migrate/check to know what a project was generated from and how to render it again. Not validated against this schema by a library at runtime (zero dependencies) — lib/qcode-core.mjs's validateConfigShape() checks the subset that matters for the rest of that module to work correctly; this file is the full documented contract.

configVersion.description: The SHAPE of this config file itself (this field's own meaning, the customized/statusGuard/boardCheck keys) — distinct from frameworkVersion, which is which QCode-Method release generated or last synced the project. migrate reads this to know how to upgrade an older config shape. Current value: 1.

frameworkVersion.description: QCode-Method VERSION at generation time, or the version last synced to.

scaffoldedAt.description: ISO date the project was generated.

syncedAt.description: ISO date of the last successful `sync --write` run. Absent until the first sync.

compassCheck.description: Whether the optional compass-check skill was installed at generation time.

customized.description: Substrings of target-relative paths the project has intentionally enriched beyond the generic template (e.g. "tech-planning" to protect a hand-enriched tech-planning/SKILL.md). sync/migrate show these as review-only diffs and never overwrite them without --force — this is how a donor project richer than the generic templates adopts framework updates without losing its enrichments.

boardCheck.description: Optional overrides for board-check.mjs's defaults. Absent or partial falls back to the built-in defaults per-key — see that file's own loadBoardCheckConfig().

statusGuard.description: Optional overrides for status-guard.sh's rule 7 (the status-event code-file detector).

codeExtensions.description: Extensions (no leading dot) that count as "source code changed" for rule 7. Defaults to ts/tsx/js/jsx/mjs/sql/py/go/rs if absent.

tokens.description: Every {{TOKEN}} value substituted at generation time, keyed by token name without the surrounding braces (e.g. "PROJECT_NAME", not "{{PROJECT_NAME}}"). See references/filling-the-gaps.md for the full token list.
